comment: FSAE 2026 V1.0 Regulation F.3.4.1 - Minimum Size Requirements (confirmed from rulebook screenshots)

A.comment: Highest strength - Front Hoop, Main Hoop, Shoulder Harness Bar

B.comment: Medium strength - FBH, Side Impact, MH Bracing, Harness Attach

C.comment: Lower strength - MH Brace Support, Component Protection, General Structural

main_hoop.description: Main Hoop (F.5.8) - single continuous steel tube, ≤10° from vertical

mh_bracing.description: Main Hoop Bracing (F.5.9) - steel only, ≥30° angle, within 160mm of top

shoulder_bar.description: Shoulder Harness Bar (F.6.5) - steel only, single continuous tube

shoulder.description: V1 shoulder harness bar alias for shoulder_bar

front_hoop.description: Front Hoop (F.5.7) - continuous tube, ≤20° from vertical above Upper SI

fbh_support.description: FBH Support (F.6.2) - ≥3 per side (upper, lower, diagonal), triangulated to FH

front_susp_mount.description: Front suspension mount support links separated from regulation FBH support tubes

fh_bracing.description: Front Hoop Bracing (F.6.3) - 1 per side, forward to FBH or triangulation

side_impact.description: Side Impact Structure (F.6.4) - ≥3 per side. Upper SI: 290-345mm from ground

mh_brace_support.description: MH Brace Support (F.6.6) - 2 per side (upper, lower), triangulation

component_protection.description: Component protection and drivetrain mounting tubes in regulation-defined frame regions

diff_mount.description: Differential mount support tubes aft of the main hoop brace trapezoid

rear_box.description: Rear box structure between the mandatory brace trapezoid and rear free-region plane

structural.description: V1 aggregate structural group; Size B conservatively covers its Size B/C members

material_restrictions.comment: F.3.2.1 / F.3.5 - Steel required only for MH, MH Bracing, and Shoulder Bar. Composites in other regulated locations require F.4.1.3 equivalence.

cockpit_template.comment: T.1.1/T.1.2 - Cockpit opening and internal section templates. Inserted from top and nose side, moved to stop point.

driver_template.comment: phi200-490-phi200-280-phi300, 50mm helmet clearance from MH-FH line

impact_attenuator.comment: F.8.4 - IA must be ≥200mm long, ≥100mm high, ≥200mm wide for ≥200mm forward of FBH

anti_intrusion_plate.comment: F.8.2/F.8.3 - AIP must align with or exceed FBH outer dimensions

section_requirements.comment: V2 group-level F.6 checks. fbh_support also provides the front-hoop bracing load path (F.6.3).
